entries.label: MGS1 — Cave / loups
entries.prompt: Create ONE wide 16:9 empty static HD painted 2D fighting stage source for CQC Versus Legacy, based carefully on the attached original-game reference. Preserve each game's specific place, architecture, palette and materials. Continuous horizontal walkable fighting strip at the front. Remove every person, vehicle, HUD, scope reticle, annotation, logo and text. No collage, no spritesheet, no UI. Metal Gear Solid 1998 Shadow Moses wolfdog CAVE, not Twin Snakes. Reference 1 is night-vision gameplay: use its rock structure and cramped jagged tunnels, but replace artificial night-vision green with the original dim cold cyan-grey lighting sampled in reference 2 at the cave exit. Map shows linked rough chambers, snow patches and one shallow puddle; it is layout evidence, do not draw a diagram. Wide side-on chamber with grey angular layered rock walls, low crawl openings at left and right, irregular snow patches in the back, dark shallow reflecting puddle at rear left, one discreet industrial metal door at far right meeting concrete exit wall as in reference 2. Front lane continuous cold stone dust with slight frost. No fantasy crystals, giant stalagmites, blue neon, wolves, characters or interface.

notes: Location and episode checked against the listed screenshot references.
Static painted HD source; perspective, hidden surfaces and fine textures are adapted and not certified as exact 1:1.
No animation, collision layout, parallax separation or runtime admission.
Night-vision structure and topology map used; original color inferred from the adjacent cave exit capture.
